name: compy
description: A complete C89 (+VLA) teaching IDE running entirely in the browser: interpreter with a real process-memory model, memory & pointer visualizer, a valgrind-for-beginners UB sandbox, emulated syscalls + libc over a virtual filesystem, full debugger, and an in-browser AI assistant.

scripts.test:all: npm run test && npm run build && npm run test:e2e
